checklist_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2G-R - Owner Authorization Decision Register

decisions_required_from_human_owner.topic: Selection of Prospective Market Data Feed Provider
decisions_required_from_human_owner.action_required: Human owner must choose and contract with a licensed data vendor.

decisions_required_from_human_owner.topic: Approval of Vendor Terms of Service for Private Research
decisions_required_from_human_owner.action_required: Human owner must independently verify and accept vendor ToS.

decisions_required_from_human_owner.topic: Formal Approval of Paired Downside Shortfall Primary Endpoint
decisions_required_from_human_owner.specification: theta_def = E[max(0, -R_E0,t) - max(0, -R_D2,t) | t in T_def] > 0 with alpha=0.05 and CAGR non-inferiority within 2.0%
decisions_required_from_human_owner.action_required: Human owner must formally approve the mathematical endpoint and non-inferiority margin.

decisions_required_from_human_owner.topic: Approval of Minimum Observation Horizon and Defensive Sample Size
decisions_required_from_human_owner.specification: 252 trading sessions with at least 30 verified defensive sessions; underpowered outcomes classified as INCONCLUSIVE
decisions_required_from_human_owner.action_required: Human owner must approve the sample size and power requirements.

decisions_required_from_human_owner.topic: Approval of Stopping and Circuit Breaker Rules
decisions_required_from_human_owner.specification: Pause at 20.0% drawdown, immediate halt on any invariant breach or negative cash
decisions_required_from_human_owner.action_required: Human owner must approve risk limits and stop-loss criteria.

decisions_required_from_human_owner.topic: Execution of Signed Cryptographic Paper-Activation Token
decisions_required_from_human_owner.specification: Generate token with owner_name, signed_utc, target_commit=b283ded200c777b130285b0aa56a0b044afbd339, feed_provider
decisions_required_from_human_owner.action_required: Human owner signs the token payload.

permanently_forbidden_actions.governance_rule: Guardian Alpha is in controlled private research. Live orders with real funds are strictly forbidden.
Gross notional leverage must not exceed 1.00x; negative cash balance is an immediate fatal fault.
Historical out-of-sample data remains permanently sealed to protect future benchmark integrity.

permanently_forbidden_actions.action: Public Redistribution of Proprietary Data or Code
permanently_forbidden_actions.governance_rule: Repository remains private and intellectual property protected.

permanently_forbidden_actions.action: Automatic Substitution of Frozen E0 Production Agent
permanently_forbidden_actions.governance_rule: E0 (agent.py) remains the frozen baseline. Candidate D2 cannot replace E0 without multi-year verified prospective track record.
